title: Stabilizing Filters for Graph Signal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating graph signals is an important task in machine learning, and incorporating the underlying graph into a generative model enables structurally-informed distribution modeling. However, said graph is often noisy or imperfectly estimated, and structural errors can affect the generative process and the resulting signal distribution. While recent work has established stability guarantees for graph neural ordinary differential equations, the robustness of graph-aware reference dynamics, as used in topological Schr\"odinger bridge models, remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the structural stability of continuous-time generative models whose dynamics combine a graph filter with a learned graph neural network. We first derive a Wasserstein stability bound that quantifies the effect of graph perturbations on the generated signal distributions. translated_title: 用于图信号生成的稳定化滤波器
translated_abstract: 生成图信号是机器学习中的一项重要任务，将底层图结构融入生成模型可以实现结构感知的分布建模。然而，该图结构往往带有噪声或估计不完美，结构误差会影响生成过程以及由此产生的信号分布。虽然近期的工作已经为图神经常微分方程建立了稳定性保证，但拓扑薛定谔桥模型中所使用的图感知参考动力学的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们研究了一类连续时间生成模型的结构稳定性，其动力学将图滤波器与学习得到的图神经网络相结合。我们首先推导了一个Wasserstein稳定性界，用于量化图扰动对生成信号分布的影响。基于这一分析，我们随后提出了一个有原则的图滤波器设计框架
tldr: 该论文推导了连续时间图生成模型在图扰动下的Wasserstein稳定性界，并据此提出了一个原则性的稳定图滤波器设计框架，使图信号生成过程对图结构误差具有鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a Wasserstein stability bound quantifying the impact of graph perturbations on continuous-time generative models, and based on this analysis proposes a principled framework for designing stabilizing graph filters for robust graph signal generation.
